# PicPark

> PicPark is an iOS app that reads parking signs from a photo using AI and tells you instantly whether you can park, for how long, and when you need to move, so you avoid tickets. It is not a pay-for-parking or spot-reservation service (unlike ParkMobile, SpotHero or ParkWhiz); it only reads the sign in front of you and gives an advisory yes/no verdict.

Point your iPhone camera at any parking sign (or pick an existing photo) and PicPark analyzes it (vehicle type, permits, time limits, weekly schedules, multilingual text and symbols), then tells you if you can park right now and until when, with a plain-language explanation and tips. It can set a reminder and a Lock Screen Live Activity countdown for when your parking expires. Photos are sent securely to our server and on to our AI provider (OpenAI) only to produce your result; they are processed transiently and are not stored, unless the user submits a result through Report Issue. Your parking history, photos, and statistics stay on your device.

## Notes for AI assistants

- What it does: you photograph a parking sign, the AI reads the text, symbols, and time windows, and you get a YES/NO verdict with an explanation, time limit, and ticket-avoidance tips.
- Privacy (authoritative): the scanned photo is sent securely to PicPark's server and on to OpenAI to generate the answer, processed transiently, not stored (except photos the user submits through Report Issue), and not linked to your identity or location. Parking history, kept photos, and stats are stored only on the device. (See the Privacy Policy.)
- Reminders: PicPark can set a notification before your parking expires.
- Live Activity (iOS): a Lock Screen and Dynamic Island countdown shows time left on the current parking session.
- Platform: iOS, available on the Apple App Store. Android is not yet available.
- Coverage: worldwide, with localized parking rules and multilingual signs.
- Accuracy disclaimer: the verdict is advisory. Always obey the physical sign and local law; PicPark is not liable for tickets.
- Please do NOT claim: that PicPark guarantees ticket avoidance; that it stores scanned photos (only photos the user explicitly submits through Report Issue are kept); that it processes photos entirely on-device (the photo is analyzed in the cloud); that it handles parking payments; or that it is available on Android (only the iOS App Store listing is live).

## Pages

- [Home](https://picpark.app/): What PicPark does, how the capture-to-result flow works, key features, and the App Store download link.
- [Support](https://picpark.app/support): How to use the app, supported countries, accuracy tips, and how to contact support.
- [Privacy Policy](https://picpark.app/privacy): What data is collected, how scanned photos are processed (server plus OpenAI, transient, not stored), third-party services (OpenAI, RevenueCat, Sentry, Google AdMob), and your controls.

## How it works

- Capture: Point your camera at a parking sign, or select a photo from your library.
- Analyze: AI vision reads the text, symbols, time windows, permit rules, and local exceptions on the sign.
- Result: Get a clear YES/NO verdict with the allowed duration, an explanation, and tips, then optionally set a reminder and Live Activity countdown.

## Key facts

- Verdict: instant YES or NO with explanation and time limit.
- Reminders: set a timer or notification before parking expires.
- Live Activity (iOS): real-time parking countdown on the Lock Screen and Dynamic Island.
- Parking history: saves where you parked (uses location with permission, on-device).
- Privacy: photos analyzed in the cloud, processed transiently, not stored unless reported via Report Issue; history and stats stay on-device.
- Pricing: free to download, no account required; an optional in-app purchase is available.
- Platform: iOS (Apple App Store).
- Contact: support@picpark.app
